purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.success: Host numerical+structural qualification passes, then frozen device qualification passes without threshold relaxation or CPU fallback.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: ACTIVE learned residual / wider student route.

L1_PHASE.goal: Learned host numerical recovery with teacher/full-Vocos CPU, QNN-CPU, disjoint heldout/stress and eventually strict HTP gates.
L1_PHASE.exit_stall: Single-boundary learned failure -> enlarge optimization unit, not rank micro-tuning.

L2_MECHANISM.name: BLOCK0_ADD3_LEARNED_RESIDUAL_FOUNDATION
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: Dangerous residual is present by block0 Add3; exact route is closed; test whether total Add3 QNN error is compactly predictable.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: Robust heldout low-rank predictability authorizes one NPU-native correction family.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Can ORT Add3 - QNN Add3 be predicted from QNN Add3 with a compact low-rank affine correction?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Dataset and 30/8/9 split are SHA-locked. Fit train only; select rank/ridge only on validation Add3 residual; holdout including warm18 remains sealed until one winner is frozen.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: Open holdout once after winner freeze; require preregistered heldout robustness or close this boundary.

L4_ACTION.action: Fit the frozen rank/ridge grid on train, score validation only, and freeze one winner before opening holdout/warm18.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: Tests learned-route viability before materializing any new ONNX correction branch.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_single_boundary_learned_failure: Escalate to adjacent-block/wider student rather than extend hyperparameter grids.
